name: Large hail (supercell)
description: Steep mid-level lapse rates + ample MU instability + deep-layer shear and helicity (longer residence in the hail growth zone). WFO Louisville tip sheet (Supercells & Hail): 700-500 mb lapse > 7.0 C/km, moderate-large CAPE, 0-6 km shear > 40-50 kt, 0-3 km SRH > 150-200 m2/s2. Starting point — tune across cycles.
